claude_proposed_widenings.name: damage_mirror
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Warding Bond's core mechanic is that the caster suffers the exact same amount of damage as the bonded target whenever the target takes damage. This is a bi-directional damage link — not grant_resistance (which halves damage on the target), not damage_on_hit (which applies additional damage to someone who was attacked), and not any existing effect atom. The caster is not in the attack resolution at all; they passively receive reflected damage from the target's resolution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation { kind: 'modify_ac' }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The +1 AC bonus is an ongoing effect that persists on the target for the spell's duration. The modify_ac concept exists in the surface as a ReactionEffect variant, but it is not in the OngoingOperation union. Warding Bond's AC bonus is not reaction-triggered — it applies passively for 1 hour.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it gains a +1 bonus to AC

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation { kind: 'grant_resistance'; damageTypes: 'all' | ReadonlyArray<DamageType> }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Resistance to all damage is an ongoing persistent effect on the target. grant_resistance is a v4 atom but it is not in the OngoingOperation union type, so it cannot be the operation of an ongoing_effect mechanics block. Additionally, the existing DamageType union does not cover 'all damage types' as a single selector — the spell grants resistance to every damage type at once.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it has Resistance to all damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffectMechanics.operations (array, not singular)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing_effect family has operation: OngoingOperation (singular). Warding Bond requires three simultaneous ongoing operations on the same target (modify_ac, modify_roll_numeric/save bonus, grant_resistance), plus the damage_mirror effect on the caster. A single operation field cannot honestly carry these.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has Resistance to all damage. Also, each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: flat numeric modifier in OngoingOperation (not DiceDelta)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The +1 saving throw bonus is a flat numeric bonus, not a dice expression. The existing RollModifierOperation uses DiceDelta which requires dice and dieSize fields (e.g., +1d4 for Bless). A flat +1 is not honestly representable with DiceDelta. A flat_modifier variant or a numeric delta type is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws
